## Change and reason

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link the relevant issue.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Explain any checks that could not run.
For documentation, check relative links and format only changed files.

## Review focus

Call out compatibility, migration, ownership, privacy or safety concerns.
Identify any required content, safety, design or accessibility review.
For UI changes, attach the screenshots and state/keyboard evidence required
by [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/NUS-FinTechAI/traders_edge_v2/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
For new assets or copied material, identify the source and reuse permission.
